facts.text: Serve the sweets when the Easter Bunny's egg hunt begins.
facts.why: In the film Pitch's Nightmares smash the Easter eggs and Easter is late, so no egg hunt begins on screen in the sources I opened. The Guardians do help paint eggs in Bunny's Warren.
facts.fix: Serve the sweets when the Guardians reach Bunny's Warren to colour the Easter eggs.

facts.why: The note says it warms the yetis after Phil's sleigh test. Phil is a yeti Jack meets in the workshop, but no source I opened shows a sleigh test.
facts.fix: Warms the yetis after a long night on the toy line.
facts.full: Warms the yetis after Phil's sleigh test.

vibe.verdict: A cosy workshop menu with good food names, but the poster shows up letterboxed and it leaves out the film's big set pieces.
missing: Jack's sleigh ride and 'Everyone loves the sleigh'
Tooth's palace and the baby teeth memories
Bunny's warren and the egg painting
Jack making a snow day for Jamie
ideas: Swap 'Iced gingerbread yetis and elves' for 'Baby tooth shortbread' as a nod to Tooth's palace.
Add 'Still waiting for cookies!' as North's note.
Swap 'Jack Frost's frosty blue slushie' for a 'Snow day' slushie to point at Jack's best scene.
Crop the poster to fill its frame so the black bars go.
